description: Install PAN for Copilot CLI locally and confirm, without a model, that Copilot lists the project's AGENTS.md among the instruction sources a session would load, and no GEMINI.md.
why: Project memory routing (ADR-0050): Copilot CLI reads AGENTS.md natively, and also CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md, so PAN points Gemini at AGENTS.md through its settings rather than writing a GEMINI.md that Copilot would load as a further copy. `copilot instruction list` prints the sources a session would load without starting one; first measured on Copilot CLI 1.0.103 (2026-10-31). SKIPPED with reason when the CLI is absent.

steps.why: The installer's contract: PAN's section, and no GEMINI.md. Routing is off by default since 3.42.2, so the table comes next, by opting in.
The empty seed has no planning config; this writes the defaults, routing off.
The project opts in to the routing table, as a project choosing advisory does.
Rewrites PAN's section for the routing mode the config now asks for.

expect: stdout~### When to use PAN in this project
steps.why: The advisory section, with its table, is on disk, and still no GEMINI.md.
The measurement: Copilot's own list of the instruction sources it would load names AGENTS.md and no GEMINI.md.

controls.why: With AGENTS.md gone, Copilot's list must not name it, which shows the listing reads this workspace.
